NUPHY-RELEASE-NOTES 1 version:1.2.46 [zh-CN] NuPhy Lab 1.2.46
• 框选新增“回复”：根据选中的对话和可选口述要求生成可复制的回复，支持在浮窗中继续调整。 • 框选快捷键支持录制鼠标侧键；按住侧键移动鼠标选择区域，松开完成。 • 改进首次授权后的状态刷新和监听恢复，分别显示系统授权与实际运行状态。 • 新增自动感光背光：在支持的 Mac 上根据环境亮度平滑调节 Lab 背光，并可按键盘型号学习亮度偏好。 • 改进 Kick75 旧固件更新引导，以及兼容固件在 Lab 灯光计时结束前提前休眠的问题。 [en] NuPhy Lab 1.2.46
• Add Reply to selection actions: draft a ready-to-copy response from the selected conversation and optional spoken requirements, with further adjustments in the answer panel. • Record a mouse side button as the selection shortcut. Hold it and move to select a region, then release to finish. • Improve permission status refresh and listener recovery after authorization, showing system access and actual runtime readiness separately. • Add automatic backlighting on supported Macs: smoothly adapt Lab lighting to ambient brightness and optionally learn brightness preferences per keyboard model. • Improve old-firmware guidance for Kick75 and prevent compatible firmware from sleeping before the Lab lighting timer ends.
